units.source_text: 吟罢嘤嘤啜泣，姿态非常可怜。

en.t: When she finished chanting, she sobbed softly, and her manner was extremely pitiable.

units.source_text: 右近看了她的模样，想道：“小姐容貌如此艳丽，但倘姿态与乡下人一样笨拙，真是白玉之瑕了。

en.t: Ukon looked at her appearance and thought, "The young lady is so beautiful, but if her bearing were as awkward as a country person's, it would truly be a flaw in white jade.

units.source_text: 怪哉，不知乳母怎样把她抚育起来的。”

en.t: How strange; I wonder how her nurse managed to bring her up."
In her heart, she felt grateful to the nurse.

units.source_text: 夕颜的风姿，只是天真活泼，温柔和悦；

en.t: Yugao's grace had been simply innocent and lively, gentle and agreeable;

units.source_text: 这个玉鬘呢，又具有高贵之相，其态度之优雅，使人看了自惭形秽。

en.t: but this Tamakazura also had an air of nobility, and the elegance of her manner made anyone who saw her feel ashamed of themselves.

units.source_text: 如此看来，筑紫是个好地方。

en.t: Seen in this way, Tsukushi must be a fine place.

units.source_text: 然而右近回想以前见过的筑紫人，都是土头土脑的，觉得不可思议。

en.t: Yet when Ukon recalled the people from Tsukushi whom she had met before, they had all been rustic and dull, which made this seem hard to understand.
